# Releasing judge-level rules (plugin). Pairs with releasing.md. Pulled in when
# the repo ships a versioned artifact (`--releasing`). One-time structural checks
# on the release wiring are buildout-only — see buildout/releasing.llmlint.yml.
# llmlint: ignore-file[changed_behavior_has_e2e] these are LLM-judge config invariants with no deterministic runtime path; the blocking model lint exercises the changed rule configuration.
version: 1.1

rules:
  - name: release_does_not_regate_an_already_swept_commit
    description: |
      true when it only computes the version, writes the changelog and manifests,
      builds, and publishes — running no lint, type-check, or test target over a
      commit the merge (or the release PR) already swept with the broader tier.
      Compiling the artifact it ships is building, not gating, and is not a
      violation.
    files:
      include:
        - ".github/workflows/**"
        - "release-plz.toml"
        - ".releaserc*"
        - "release-please*"
    relevance: the target files define a release, tag, or publish workflow
    require_line_attribution: true
